2609.40071.title: Grounding Time-Series Foundation Models in Digital Twin Topology for Predictive Maintenance
2609.40071.paper_summary: Digital twins increasingly support downstream analytical tasks that depend on time-series data, motivating interest in time-series foundation models (TSFMs) as scalable backbones. However, TSFMs are primarily pretrained for temporal continuation and often underperform on unseen tasks such as regression, and systematic empirical comparisons against state-of-the-art dedicated models in digital twin contexts remain limited. This paper makes three contributions. First, we benchmark five well-known TSFMs with frozen backbones on remaining useful life (RUL) prediction using the C-MAPSS dataset, finding that multivariate architectures substantially outperform univariate ones, particularly under varying operating conditions. This raises a deeper question: when cross-channel dependencies can be modeled through pretrained weights, target-task adaptation, and digital twin-derived representations, how much does each contribute, and are they complementary? Second, we propose a topology-informed fusion approach in which topological constraints, derived from the asset structure the digital twin stores among its information models, explicitly shape cross-attention, so that fused representations respect the physical system's local connectivity rather than relying on unconstrained all-to-all interactions. Third, we conduct an ablation study across C-MAPSS subsets of varying operational complexity that isolates the three sources and their interactions. The sources prove complementary rather than redundant, and topology-constrained attention outperforms unconstrained fusion, though by a small margin, enabling a frozen TSFM informed by digital twin representations to remain competitive or in some cases exceed state-of-the-art performance on this regression task.
2609.40071.paper_summary_zh: 數位雙胞胎越來越多地支持依賴時間序列數據的下游分析任務，這激發了對時間序列基礎模型（TSFMs）作為可擴展骨幹的興趣。<lb/>然而，TSFMs 主要是針對時間延續進行預訓練，並且在未見過的任務（如回歸）上表現不佳，且在數位雙胞胎背景下與最先進專用模型的系統性實證比較仍然有限。<lb/>本文做出了三項貢獻。<lb/>首先，我們使用 C-MAPSS 數據集對五個知名的 TSFMs 進行基準測試，這些模型的骨幹是固定的，並針對剩餘使用壽命（RUL）預測進行評估，發現多變量架構在不同的操作條件下顯著優於單變量架構。<lb/>這引發了一個更深層次的問題：當跨通道依賴可以通過預訓練權重、目標任務適應和數位雙胞胎衍生的表徵進行建模時，每個因素貢獻多少，且它們是互補的嗎？<lb/>其次，我們提出了一種拓撲知情的融合方法，其中來自數位雙胞胎在其信息模型中存儲的資產結構衍生的拓撲約束明確地塑造了跨注意力，使得融合的表徵尊重物理系統的局部連接性，而不是依賴於不受約束的全對全交互。<lb/>第三，我們在 C-MAPSS 的不同操作複雜性子集上進行了消融研究，以隔離這三個來源及其相互作用。<lb/>這些來源被證明是互補的而非冗餘的，且受拓撲約束的注意力在性能上優於不受約束的融合，儘管差距不大，使得受數位雙胞胎表徵啟發的固定 TSFM 能夠在這一回歸任務中保持競爭力，甚至在某些情況下超越最先進的性能。
